classification.difficultyReason: A single hinted logistic IVP with numeric k and a point evaluation. It is the same procedure as the hinted logistic solves in the ladder, with no extra reasoning.

content.prompt:
A koala colony on an island satisfies $\dfrac{dP}{dt}=\dfrac16P\left(1-\dfrac{P}{1200}\right)$, $P(0)=150$, $t$ in years.

Use
$$\frac{1200}{P(1200-P)}=\frac1P+\frac1{1200-P}.$$
Find $P(t)$ and $P(12)$. Give $P(12)$ to the nearest whole koala.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{dt}{dP}&=\frac{7200}{P(1200-P)}\\
\frac{dt}{dP}&=6\left(\frac1P+\frac1{1200-P}\right)\\
t&=6\bigl(\ln|P|-\ln|1200-P|\bigr)+D\\
\ln\left|\frac{P}{1200-P}\right|&=\frac t6-\frac D6\\
\frac{P}{1200-P}&=Ae^{t/6}.
\end{aligned}$$
Using $P(0)=150$,
$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{150}{1050}&=Ae^0\\
A&=\frac17.
\end{aligned}$$
Hence
$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{P}{1200-P}&=\frac17e^{t/6}\\
7P&=(1200-P)e^{t/6}\\
P(7+e^{t/6})&=1200e^{t/6}\\
P(t)&=\frac{1200}{1+7e^{-t/6}}\\
P(12)&=\frac{1200}{1+7e^{-2}}\\
P(12)&\approx616.
\end{aligned}$$
